text:
maria: Hey folks — quick personal update: our adoption was finalized this morning! Baby Jun is officially ours 🎉👶🏽. We're home-safe and everyone is sleepy but happy. Huge thanks to the team for covering during my leave — you all made it so much easier. I'll post a photo later when there's daylight.
sam: OMG congrats!!! so happy for you ❤️
lina: this is the best news. welcome to the family, Jun!! when can we bring over the ridiculous congratulations cupcakes? :cupcake:
tom: congrats Maria!! if you need help with anything at all, shout. also — parental leave docs updated, right @hr-bot?
hr-bot: @tom Parental leave status: Completed for maria. Remaining paid time: 12 weeks. The HR team will follow up with next steps.
ella: tears!!! can't wait to meet them. when's the baby meet-and-greet? 😭
maria: Thanks everyone!! We'll do a tiny hangout in two weeks — date tbd. Photos soon. ❤️
ben: sending diapers and bad dad jokes — what's the address? (jk, DMing you) :sweat_smile:
samir: amazing news. congrats again. also — +1 cupcake offer from me.
liz: :partyparrot: absolute joy. so happy for your family.
maria: quick note — please don't post pics publicly; we appreciate privacy. DM is fine. thank you!
tom: noted. no public posts. congrats again!! :tada:
